title: Trove travel segment
description: One line of travel/<source>/YYYY-MM.jsonl: a single trip segment (flight, lodging, car, train, …), keyed by guid. Additive evolution: readers tolerate unknown fields.

ts.description: RFC3339 local time of the segment's start (departure, check-in, pickup); the partition key

source.description: collector id; identical to the source folder name (lowercase/digits/dash)

guid.description: source-unique id, the dedupe key (ICS UID, Airbnb confirmation code, Flighty row id, booking-ref+segment, or a date+route+number hash)

end_ts.description: RFC3339 local arrival / check-out / drop-off, when known

start_place.description: origin: airport/station code (IATA where it has one) or city — the departure/check-in place

start_place_name.description: display name for start_place (airport name, hotel/listing name, city label)

end_place.description: destination: airport/station code or city (flights, trains, transfers, one-way car rentals)

vendor.description: operating brand: airline, hotel/lodging brand, rental company, rail operator

confirmation.description: confirmation / record-locator / booking code shown to the traveller

booking_id.description: groups segments of one itinerary/trip (a multi-leg booking, a flight-emails booking ref)

status.description: source-native state (open string: confirmed, canceled, completed, delayed, …)

extra.description: everything source-specific (seat, terminal, gate, room, address, car class, amount, delay minutes, aircraft, weather, …)
